description: Natural scrolling direction. When on, content moves in the same direction as your fingers (trackpad and mouse wheel scroll the page down when you swipe down).
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Scroll & Zoom → Natural Scrolling
notes: Values appear as True/False when read from .GlobalPreferences.plist directly, or 1/0 via defaults export. True/1 = natural scrolling on, False/0 = off. Also applies to mouse scroll wheel direction.

description: Controls when scroll bars are visible in windows and lists.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Show scroll bars
notes: Values: Always, WhenScrolling, Automatic (based on mouse/trackpad presence).

description: Sub-pixel font smoothing (anti-aliasing) for non-Retina displays. Apple removed the UI toggle in macOS 14; the key persists for older displays.
notes: 0 = off, 1 = light, 2 = medium, 3 = strong. Absent key means system default (on for non-Retina, off for Retina).

description: Enables dragging windows and selecting text by swiping with three fingers on the built-in trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Pointer Control → Trackpad Options → Use trackpad for dragging → Three Finger Drag
notes: Enabling this disables three-finger swipe for Mission Control/Spaces navigation. Mirror key exists in com.apple.driver.AppleBluetoothMultitouch.trackpad for Bluetooth trackpads.

description: Enables dragging windows and selecting text by swiping with three fingers on an external Bluetooth trackpad (Magic Trackpad).
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Pointer Control → Trackpad Options → Use trackpad for dragging → Three Finger Drag
notes: Counterpart to com.apple.AppleMultitouchTrackpad for external Bluetooth trackpads.

description: Reduces the motion of the user interface, replacing animations (zoom effects, parallax, animated backgrounds) with simpler crossfade transitions.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Display → Reduce Motion

description: Master on/off switch for Stage Manager, which organises open windows into a focused set with other windows arranged in a strip on the left.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Stage Manager

description: When Stage Manager is active, automatically hides the recent apps strip on the left until you move the pointer there.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Stage Manager → Show recent apps in Stage Manager
notes: 1 = auto-hide strip, 0 = always show strip.

description: When Stage Manager is active, hides files and folders on the desktop until you click the desktop.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Stage Manager → Show Items → On Desktop
notes: May also appear as StandardHideDesktopIcons in later macOS builds.

description: Stage Manager menu bar visibility setting — whether the Stage Manager toggle button appears in the menu bar or only inside Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Stage Manager
notes: Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only. Distinct from com.apple.WindowManager.GloballyEnabled which is the actual Stage Manager on/off state.

description: Controls whether the Battery indicator appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Battery
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist (domain normalises to com.apple.controlcenter). Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only, 16 = always show.

description: Controls whether the Wi-Fi indicator appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Wi-Fi
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only.

description: Controls whether the Bluetooth indicator appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Bluetooth
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only.

description: Controls whether the AirDrop button appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → AirDrop
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only.

description: Controls whether the Focus indicator appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Focus
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only, 18 = always show in menu bar.

description: Controls whether the Sound/volume indicator appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Sound
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only, 18 = always show in menu bar.

description: Controls whether the Display brightness indicator appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Display
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only, 18 = always show in menu bar.

description: Controls whether the Now Playing media controls appear in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Now Playing
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only, 18 = always show in menu bar.

description: Controls whether the Siri button appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Siri
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only.

description: Controls whether the Screen Mirroring / AirPlay Display button appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Screen Mirroring
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only, 18 = always show.

description: Controls whether the Fast User Switching button appears in the menu bar.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Fast User Switching
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only.

description: Controls whether the Weather summary appears in the menu bar or only in Control Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Control Center → Weather
notes: Stored in the ByHost plist. Values: 2 = in menu bar, 8 = in Control Center only.

description: Master on/off switch for Siri.
ui_location: System Settings → Siri & Spotlight → Ask Siri
notes: Key name contains a space. 1 = Siri enabled, 0 = disabled.

description: Enables Hey Siri voice activation, allowing Siri to be invoked hands-free.
ui_location: System Settings → Siri & Spotlight → Listen for
notes: Requires T2 chip or Apple silicon. 0 = off, 1 = on.

description: Controls whether Siri and Dictation audio is shared with Apple to improve recognition.
ui_location: System Settings → Siri & Spotlight → Improve Siri & Dictation
notes: Key name contains spaces. Values: 1 = opted in (sharing on), 2 or 3 = opted out.

description: Global setting for when notification previews (message content) are shown on screen.
ui_location: System Settings → Notifications → Show Previews
notes: Values: 0 = Always (default), 1 = When Unlocked, 2 = Never. Individual apps can override this global setting.

description: Controls how notifications are ordered in Notification Center.
ui_location: System Settings → Notifications → Notification Center → Sort Notification Center by
notes: Values: 0 = By recency, 1 = By app.

description: Controls whether notifications are suppressed when the display is sleeping.
ui_location: System Settings → Notifications → Allow notifications when the display is sleeping
notes: Stored as a nested binary plist under dnd_prefs. True = suppress (show nothing), False = allow notifications.

description: Controls whether notifications are suppressed when the screen is locked.
ui_location: System Settings → Notifications → Allow notifications when the screen is locked
notes: Stored as a nested binary plist under dnd_prefs. True = suppress, False = allow.

description: Allows FaceTime calls to ring through even when a Focus mode is active.
ui_location: System Settings → Focus → (any Focus mode) → People → Allow Calls From
notes: Stored as a nested binary plist under dnd_prefs in ncprefs.

description: When enabled, a second FaceTime call from the same person within three minutes breaks through a Focus mode.
ui_location: System Settings → Focus → (any Focus mode) → People → Allow Repeated Calls
notes: Stored as a nested binary plist under dnd_prefs in ncprefs.

description: Controls whether Focus modes are shared and synced across all your Apple devices signed in to the same Apple ID.
ui_location: System Settings → Focus → Share Across Devices
notes: Inverted: 1/True = sharing DISABLED, 0/False = sharing ENABLED.

description: Automatically downloads macOS and app updates in the background so they are ready to install.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic Updates → Download new updates when available
notes: Stored in /Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate.plist (system-level, requires admin).

description: Automatically installs macOS updates overnight. When on, the system may prompt to restart after downloading a major update.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic Updates → Install macOS updates
notes: Stored in /Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate.plist (system-level, requires admin).

description: Automatically installs security responses and system data files (Rapid Security Responses, XProtect updates, MRT).
ui_location: System Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic Updates → Install Security Responses and system files
notes: Stored in /Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate.plist (system-level, requires admin).

description: Automatically installs configuration data files that keep system security databases (like malware definitions) current.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Software Update → Automatic Updates → Install Security Responses and system files
notes: Stored in /Library/Preferences/com.apple.SoftwareUpdate.plist. Often changes together with CriticalUpdateInstall.

description: SetShot end-to-end test key. This is a synthetic canary entry used to verify the app can recognise and display a known settings change.
notes: Created for canary testing. Write before/after values with: defaults write com.apple.SetShotCanary CanaryTest -string "value"

description: Light or Dark Mode. When set to 'Dark', the system uses dark backgrounds throughout the UI. Absent key means Light Mode.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Appearance
notes: Value: 'Dark' = dark mode; key absent or any other value = light mode.

description: Automatically switches between Light and Dark Mode based on time of day.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Appearance → Auto
notes: Only present when Automatic is selected.

description: Accent color used for buttons, highlighted text, and other interactive elements.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Accent color
notes: Values: -1=Graphite, 0=Red, 1=Orange, 2=Yellow, 3=Green, 4=Blue (default), 5=Purple, 6=Pink. Key absent = Multicolor.

description: Highlight color used for selected text.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Highlight color
notes: String containing RGB floats and a color name, e.g. '0.698039 0.843137 1.000000 Blue'.

description: Liquid Glass tinting: when ON, the glass effect in the menu bar and windows picks up the desktop color.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Tinted

description: App icon style. Controls whether icons are colorful (Default), tinted, or monochrome.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Icon style
notes: Values: 'Default', 'TintedLight', 'TintedDark'.

description: Folder tint color when icon style is set to Tinted.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Folder color

description: When ON, windows and panels do not pick up color from the desktop background (reduces wallpaper tinting).
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Allow wallpaper tinting in windows
notes: True/1 = tinting OFF (reduced); False/0 or absent = tinting ON.

description: Controls what happens when clicking in the scroll bar track: jump to the clicked spot or jump to the next page.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Click in the scroll bar to
notes: True/1 = jump to clicked spot; False/0 or absent = jump to next page.

description: Controls the size of sidebar icons and list view row height throughout the system.
ui_location: System Settings → Appearance → Sidebar icon size
notes: Values: 1=Small, 2=Medium, 3=Large.

description: Whether the menu bar is visible while an app is in full-screen mode.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Automatically hide and show the menu bar (In Full Screen Only)

description: When switching to an app, macOS automatically switches to the Space that app is in.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Mission Control → When switching to an application, switch to a Space with open windows for the application

description: Ask whether to keep unsaved changes when closing a document window, rather than auto-saving.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Ask to keep changes when closing documents

description: When quitting an app, restore its windows the next time it is launched.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Close windows when quitting an application
notes: True/1 = windows are KEPT/restored (Close Windows = OFF); False/0 = windows close on quit.

description: Controls when documents open in tabs rather than separate windows.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Prefer tabs when opening documents
notes: Values: 'manual', 'always', 'fullscreen' (In Full Screen Only).

description: Action when double-clicking a window title bar: Minimize, Maximize, or nothing.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Double-click a window's title bar to
notes: Values: 'Maximize', 'Minimize', 'None'. Overrides AppleMiniaturizeOnDoubleClick when set.

description: Whether double-clicking a window title bar minimizes the window. Legacy key, superseded by AppleActionOnDoubleClick.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Double-click a window's title bar to

description: Spring-loaded folders: hovering over a folder while dragging opens it automatically.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Spring-loaded folders and windows

description: Swipe between pages (e.g., in Safari or Preview) using two fingers on a trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → More Gestures → Swipe between pages

description: Animate scroll actions (smooth scrolling).
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Display → Reduce Motion

description: Display time using a 24-hour clock rather than 12-hour AM/PM.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Language & Region → Time format → 24-hour time

description: Regional format settings (number separators, date formats, currency symbol).
ui_location: System Settings → General → Language & Region → Region
notes: Format: locale_CC or locale_CC@calendar=gregorian. E.g. 'en_US', 'de_DE@calendar=gregorian'.

description: Primary system language. All apps use this language unless they specify otherwise.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Language & Region → Preferred languages (first entry)

description: First day of the week in calendars and date pickers.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Language & Region → First day of week
notes: Values: 1=Sunday, 2=Monday, 7=Saturday.

description: Temperature unit used system-wide (in Weather, Siri, etc.).
ui_location: System Settings → General → Language & Region → Temperature
notes: Values: 'Celsius', 'Fahrenheit'.

description: Whether to use metric units for measurements.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Language & Region → Measurement system

description: Measurement system used for distances and lengths.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Language & Region → Measurement system
notes: Values: 'Inches', 'Centimeters'.

description: Tap to click on trackpad: allows a light tap on the trackpad surface to register as a click.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Tap to click
notes: 1 = tap to click ON; key absent or 0 = OFF.

description: Enable right-click via two-finger tap or corner tap on the trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Secondary click

description: Tap to click: register a light tap as a click on the built-in trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Tap to click

description: Tap to click: register a light tap as a click on the Bluetooth trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Tap to click

description: Enable secondary (right) click by tapping or clicking in the corner of the built-in trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Secondary click

description: Enable secondary (right) click on the Bluetooth trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Secondary click

description: Force click (deep press) on the built-in trackpad is enabled.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Force Click and haptic feedback

description: Force click is suppressed/disabled on the built-in trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Force Click and haptic feedback
notes: True/1 = force click OFF; False/0 = force click ON. Inverted from ActuateDetents.

description: How much pressure is required for a regular click on the built-in trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Click (pressure)
notes: 0=Light, 1=Medium, 2=Firm.

description: How much pressure is required for a force click (deep press) on the built-in trackpad.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Force Click (pressure)
notes: 0=Light, 1=Medium, 2=Firm.

description: Force click (deep press) on the trackpad is enabled — NSGlobalDomain mirror of the per-trackpad setting.
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Force Click and haptic feedback

description: Trackpad tracking speed (how far the pointer moves per unit of finger movement).
ui_location: System Settings → Trackpad → Point & Click → Tracking speed

description: Mouse tracking speed (how far the pointer moves per unit of mouse movement).
ui_location: System Settings → Mouse → Tracking speed

description: Mouse scroll wheel speed.
ui_location: System Settings → Mouse → Scrolling speed

description: Maximum time interval between two clicks for them to register as a double-click.
ui_location: System Settings → Mouse → Double-Click speed

description: Disable mouse pointer acceleration (linear tracking). When ON, pointer speed is constant regardless of movement speed.
ui_location: System Settings → Mouse → Natural scrolling
notes: 1/True = acceleration OFF (linear); 0/False or absent = acceleration ON (default).

description: Swap the primary and secondary mouse buttons (makes right button the primary).
ui_location: System Settings → Mouse → Primary mouse button

description: Secondary click configuration for the Bluetooth mouse.
ui_location: System Settings → Mouse → Secondary click
notes: Values: 'OneButton'=Off, 'TwoButton'/'RightHanded'=Click Right Side, 'LeftHanded'=Click Left Side.

description: Keyboard shortcut to start Dictation.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Dictation shortcut
notes: 0=Off, 1=Control×2, 2=Globe×2, 3=Right Cmd×2, 4=Left Cmd×2, 5=Either Cmd×2.

description: Action performed when pressing the Globe (fn) key.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Press Globe key to
notes: 0=Do Nothing, 1=Change Input Source, 2=Show Emoji & Symbols, 3=Start Dictation.

description: How quickly a held key repeats after the initial delay. Lower values produce faster repeat.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Key repeat rate
notes: Range roughly 2 (fast) to 120 (slow). 300000 or higher = key repeat disabled.

description: How long a key must be held before it starts repeating. Lower values start repeating sooner.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Delay until repeat

description: Full Keyboard Access: whether the Tab key can move focus to all UI controls or only text fields.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Keyboard navigation
notes: 2 or 3 = All controls (Full Keyboard Access); 0 or absent = Text fields and lists only.

description: Double-space automatically inserts a period followed by a space.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Text Input → Edit → Add period with double-space

description: Automatically capitalize the first word of a sentence while typing.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Text Input → Edit → Capitalize words automatically

description: Automatically replace double-hyphens (--) with an em dash (—).
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Text Input → Edit → Use smart dashes

description: Automatically replace straight quotes with typographic (curly) quotes.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Text Input → Edit → Use smart quotes

description: Show inline text predictions as you type that can be accepted with the Tab key.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Text Input → Edit → Show inline predictions

description: Order in which first and last names are displayed in contacts and elsewhere.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Language & Region → Name format
notes: 0=Family name first, 1=Given name first.

description: System alert sound. Value is the full path to the .aiff sound file.
ui_location: System Settings → Sound → Sound Effects → Alert sound
notes: E.g. '/System/Library/Sounds/Tink.aiff' (Boop). Absent key = default sound.

description: System alert sound volume as a fraction from 0.0 (silent) to 1.0 (full).
ui_location: System Settings → Sound → Sound Effects → Alert volume

description: Play UI sound effects for actions like emptying the Trash or dragging items.
ui_location: System Settings → Sound → Sound Effects → Play sound effects

description: Play a feedback sound when the volume is changed using keyboard keys.
ui_location: System Settings → Sound → Sound Effects → Play feedback when volume is changed

description: Flash the screen as a visual alternative to the alert sound.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Audio → Flash the screen when an alert sound occurs

description: Whether alert sounds are routed to the selected sound output device or always to the built-in speakers.
ui_location: System Settings → Sound → Sound Effects → Play sound effects through
notes: 1/True = Selected Sound Output Device; 0/False = Speakers.

description: Whether the startup chime plays when the Mac turns on.
ui_location: System Settings → Sound → Sound Effects → Play sound on startup
notes: %00 = chime ON (mute disabled); %01 = chime OFF (muted).

description: Background sounds: continuous ambient sound (rain, ocean, white noise, etc.) that plays through speakers.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Audio → Background Sounds

description: The currently selected background sound.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Audio → Background Sounds → Sound

description: Background sound volume as a fraction from 0.0 to 1.0.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Audio → Background Sounds → Volume

description: Whether background sounds stop when the screen locks.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Audio → Background Sounds → Turn off when display is locked

description: Tinnitus filter for background sounds, optimized for tinnitus relief.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Audio → Background Sounds → Use for tinnitus relief

description: Enable a sleep timer for background sounds.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Audio → Background Sounds → Timer

description: Duration of the background sounds sleep timer in seconds.
ui_location: System Settings → Accessibility → Audio → Background Sounds → Timer → Duration

description: How many seconds of inactivity before the screen saver starts. 0 = never.
ui_location: System Settings → Screen Saver → Start after

description: Show a clock overlay while the screen saver is running.
ui_location: System Settings → Screen Saver → Show clock

description: Require the user password to dismiss the screen saver or wake from display sleep.
ui_location: System Settings → Lock Screen → Require password after screen saver begins or display is turned off

description: How many seconds after the screen saver begins before a password is required to unlock.
ui_location: System Settings → Lock Screen → Require password after delay
notes: 0 = immediately. Large value (e.g. 2147483647) = never ask.

description: Name of the active screen saver module.
ui_location: System Settings → Screen Saver

description: Lock screen when a smart card or security key is removed.
ui_location: System Settings → Lock Screen → Lock when smart card is removed
notes: 1 = lock on removal; 0 = do not lock.

description: Delay (in seconds) before a password is required after the screen saver or display sleep begins.
ui_location: System Settings → Lock Screen → Require password after delay
notes: Mirror of com.apple.screensaver::askForPasswordDelay in some macOS versions.

description: Automatically hide and show the Dock when the mouse moves away from or toward its screen edge.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Automatically hide and show the Dock

description: Size of icons in the Dock in points.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Size

description: Magnify Dock icons when the pointer hovers over them.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Magnification

description: Maximum icon size (in points) when Dock magnification is hovering.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Magnification size

description: Screen edge where the Dock appears.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Position on screen
notes: Values: 'bottom', 'left', 'right'.

description: Show recently opened apps in a separate section at the end of the Dock.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Show recent applications in Dock

description: Animate app icons in the Dock when they are opened.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Animate opening applications

description: Animation used when minimizing windows to the Dock.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Minimize windows using
notes: Values: 'genie', 'scale', 'suck'.

description: Minimize windows into their application icon in the Dock instead of a separate tile.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Minimize windows into application icon

description: Show dots below running application icons in the Dock.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Show indicators for open applications

description: Automatically rearrange Spaces based on most recent use.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Mission Control → Automatically rearrange Spaces based on most recent use

description: In Mission Control, group windows from the same application together.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Mission Control → Group windows by application

description: Spread thumb and three fingers on the trackpad to show the desktop.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Show Desktop → Trackpad gesture

description: Whether each display has its own set of Spaces, or all displays share the same Spaces.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Mission Control → Displays have separate Spaces

description: Widget appearance: controls color style (macOS 15 and earlier) or whether widgets dim on the desktop (macOS 26+).
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Widget style
notes: macOS 15-: 0=Automatic, 1=Monochrome, 2=Full Color. macOS 26+: 0=Always dim, 1=Never dim, 2=Auto dim.

description: Hide all items on the desktop when Stage Manager is active.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Stage Manager → Show Items on Desktop

description: Add spacing margins between windows when using Window Tiling.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Windows → Tiled windows have margins

description: Drag a window to the left, right, or bottom screen edge to tile it.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Windows → Drag windows to screen edges to tile

description: Drag a window to the top edge to tile it.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Windows → Drag windows to screen top to tile

description: Hold the Option key while dragging a window to reveal tiling layout options.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Windows → Hold Option key while moving windows to tile

description: In Stage Manager, whether windows from the same app are grouped together or shown separately.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Stage Manager → Group windows by application
notes: 1=Together, 0=Separate.

description: Click the wallpaper to reveal the desktop when all windows are minimized or moved.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Desktop → Click wallpaper to reveal desktop

description: Hide widgets on the desktop when Stage Manager is active.
ui_location: System Settings → Desktop & Dock → Stage Manager → Show Widgets on Desktop

description: Show internal hard drive icons on the desktop.
ui_location: System Settings → General → Desktop & Dock is not the right place — Finder → Settings → General → Hard disks

description: Show external and network drive icons on the desktop when connected.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → General → External disks

description: Show CDs, DVDs, and iPods on the desktop when connected.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → General → CDs, DVDs, and iPods

description: Show connected servers on the desktop.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → General → Connected servers

description: Folder shown when a new Finder window is opened.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → General → New Finder windows show
notes: Values: 'PfHm'=Home, 'PfDe'=Desktop, 'PfDo'=Documents, 'PfCm'=Computer, 'PfRe'=Recents, 'PfLo'=Other.

description: Show a warning dialog when a file's extension is changed.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → Advanced → Show warning before changing an extension

description: Automatically delete items from the Trash that are 30 days old.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → Advanced → Remove items from Trash after 30 days

description: Show a confirmation dialog before emptying the Trash.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → Advanced → Show warning before emptying Trash

description: Show the path bar at the bottom of Finder windows, listing the hierarchy of folders.
ui_location: Finder → View → Show Path Bar

description: Show the status bar at the bottom of Finder windows with item counts and disk space.
ui_location: Finder → View → Show Status Bar

description: Show the tab bar in Finder windows.
ui_location: Finder → View → Show Tab Bar

description: Default view style for new Finder windows.
ui_location: Finder → View menu (sets default)
notes: Values: 'icnv'=Icon, 'Nlsv'=List, 'clmv'=Column, 'glyv'=Gallery.

description: Keep folders at the top when sorting Finder windows by name.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → Advanced → Keep folders on top: In windows when sorting by name

description: Keep folders at the top when sorting desktop icons by name.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → Advanced → Keep folders on top: On Desktop

description: Default scope for Finder searches.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → Advanced → When performing a search
notes: Values: 'SCev'=This Mac, 'SCcf'=Current Folder, 'SCsp'=Previous Search Scope.

description: Show hidden files and folders (those whose names begin with a dot) in Finder.
ui_location: Finder → View → Show Hidden Files (or Shift-Cmd-.)

description: Show the file extension for all files in Finder, overriding per-file hide-extension settings.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → Advanced → Show all filename extensions

description: Open folders in tabs rather than new windows when double-clicking.
ui_location: Finder → Settings → General → Open folders in tabs instead of new windows

description: Automatically resize columns to fit content in Finder column view.
ui_location: Finder → View → Customize (column view settings)

description: Enable Dictation: allows typing using your voice.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Dictation

description: Automatically add punctuation when dictating text.
ui_location: System Settings → Keyboard → Dictation → Auto-punctuation

description: Allow Siri to respond when the device is locked.
ui_location: System Settings → Siri → Allow Siri when locked

description: Enable 'Hey Siri' (voice activation) from the voicetrigger daemon.
ui_location: System Settings → Siri → Ask Siri → Listen for

description: Which voice activation phrase is used to summon Siri.
ui_location: System Settings → Siri → Ask Siri → Listen for
notes: 0='Hey Siri', 1='Siri'.

description: How Siri delivers spoken responses.
